🚀 Big Launches.title: Jalapeño custom inference chip
🚀 Big Launches.summary: OpenAI unveiled its Jalapeño inference chip, delivering up to 2× faster throughput and significantly lower latency and power use for modern LLMs. Why it matters: hardware‑model co‑design is a new competitive moat and interview candidates should be ready to discuss chip‑level optimizations.

🚀 Big Launches.title: Granite 4.2 LLMs: How They're Built
🚀 Big Launches.summary: IBM released the Granite 4.2 series (7B‑70B parameters) on Hugging Face, optimized for instruction following and retrieval‑augmented generation. Why it matters: a free, high‑quality open‑source model that students can fine‑tune for projects and interview demos.

🎯 Interview Edge.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
🎯 Interview Edge.summary: OpenAI’s CFO explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to lower cost per token and boost utility. Why it matters: interviewers expect candidates to think about end‑to‑end system scaling, not just isolated models.

🎯 Interview Edge.title: Robotics startup Generalist reaches $3B valuation
🎯 Interview Edge.summary: Generalist, a robotics‑AI startup, raised $200 M, pushing its valuation to $3 B as it expands general‑purpose robot control capabilities. Why it matters: signals rapid growth in embodied AI, a hot topic for interviews on robotics, RL, and real‑world deployment.

🔮 On the Horizon.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: a compressed, 4-bit model that outperforms its full-precision original
🔮 On the Horizon.summary: A new 4‑bit quantization‑aware healing technique compresses models while achieving higher accuracy than the original full‑precision version on benchmark tasks. Why it matters: showcases that aggressive quantization can improve performance, a cutting‑edge topic for MLOps and model‑optimization interviews.

tool_of_day.title: Granite 4.2 LLMs (open‑source)
tool_of_day.summary: Free, instruction‑tuned LLMs ranging from 7B to 70B parameters, ready for fine‑tuning or RAG experiments on Hugging Face.

hot_take: Today's mix of custom hardware, open‑source LLMs, and aggressive quantization shows that mastering both the stack and efficiency tricks is becoming essential for AI engineers.
